independent_focused_gate.scope: Only signal-first-admission, known-exited-failure admission, repeated-signal/journal drain, and unconfirmed-drain exclusion fixtures; inert subprocesses, no sampler fixture execution.

limits_and_conditions: The tool generates static flux-weighted equilibrium parents only. It does not draw Maxwell momenta, propagate recrossing children or demonstrate dynamical bead convergence.
Eight independent equilibrium chains are the uncertainty units; 1600 stored configurations are correlated observations, not 1600 independent units.
Overlap>=0.2, diagnostic energy ESS>=200 and absolute temporal-half log difference<=0.2 are registered screens, not mathematical convergence or accuracy bounds.
No automatic new seed, draw-count, horizon or budget extension is authorized by a failed or incomplete result. Separate explicit root authorization is needed for any resume.
The unchanged scientific producer does not acquire the new coordinator lease. Root must ensure no direct producer or other dispatcher writes these new output directories concurrently.

On deadline/failure the coordinator may terminate and reap only its own process groups; latest atomic checkpoints and all partial/error artifacts remain. This is bounded shutdown, not a promise of natural completion of unfinished chains.
The 15 second finalization reserve sits within the 7200 second campaign budget. Failure or unconfirmed cleanup cannot publish eligible parents.
Root must separately confirm prerequisite queues actually drained and current project worker allocation; this read-only review is not that operational authorization.
positive_checks: All four historical replays bind exact original settings, model/runtime and source bytes; only snapshot_interval changes from 0 to 100.
All 16 non-observation payload arrays require key, dtype, shape and exact C-order byte equality, including the RNG string. No float tolerance substitutes for replay identity.
Only fingerprint, endpoint_q and endpoint_completed_sweeps may differ; reference and domain files require byte equality, scientific report fields equality.

The unchanged producer snapshot path constructs new arrays without RNG draws or writes into sampler state. Existing analytic interrupted replay and valid-envelope tampering tests exercise this contract.

Every final chain requires 22000 sweeps, 20000 energy observations, 2000 diagnostic observations and 200 fixed endpoint frames; full endpoint geometry, bead domain and zero-COM conventions are checked.
All eight fixed chains and all original sampling flags are required for the single atomic child-eligible manifest. Four completed chains or one failed flag cannot enable children.
Completed producer state on explicit resume is verified and reused without recompression or resampling; incomplete state uses the frozen checkpoint/RNG resume path.
A sibling directory lease excludes other invocations; hard-crash locks persist, deferred signals stay installed through drainage, and unconfirmed drainage retains exclusion.
The authorization binds exact source/design/gates/independent review and actual queue-drain/resource evidence; one or two distinct worker CPUs and one thread per worker are enforced.
Parent rows preserve the BAR log correction alongside complete checkpoint/report/settings/domain identities for later covariance-aware child analysis.

recorded_owner_gate.scope: Tiny analytic P4 sampler fixtures plus inert subprocesses; no BKMP2 or physical dynamics.

resolved_findings.resolution: Both inner admission checks now run immediately before selecting work and before Popen after command construction. Signals/deadlines stop further admissions and full fixed-cohort unstarted identity is retained.

The same checks poll every still-owned active process for an already available nonzero status. Failed processes remain owned for drain/reap. The deterministic test observes exit 3 with waitid(WNOWAIT) before the next free slot and verifies that only the first seed launched.

verdict: No remaining blocker found for the fixed eight-chain parent-only tool at the bound final source. Actual parent execution requires separate root resource/adoption authorization.
